proposal.command:
shopt -s nullglob dotglob
directory='./incoming'
pattern='*.txt'
matches=()
for file in "$directory"/*; do
  [ -f "$file" ] || continue
  case "${file##*/}" in $pattern) matches[${#matches[@]}]=$file ;; esac
done
if [ "${#matches[@]}" -ne 1 ]; then printf '%s\n' 'Expected exactly one matching regular file.' >&2; exit 1; fi
cp -- "${matches[0]}" './copied.txt'
proposal.explanation: Copy the single matching regular file and preserve its source.

proposal.command:
shopt -s nullglob dotglob
newest=
for file in ./Downloads/*; do
  [ -f "$file" ] || continue
  if [ -z "$newest" ] || [ "$file" -nt "$newest" ]; then
    newest=$file
  fi
done
if [ -z "$newest" ]; then
  printf "%s\n" "No regular files found." >&2
  exit 1
fi
cp -- "$newest" ./selected.txt
proposal.explanation: Find the most recently modified regular file in ./Downloads (including hidden files) and copy it to ./selected.txt.
